newsitem.title: USA: National City Q1 net charge-offs higher.
newsitem.headline: National City Q1 net charge-offs higher.

text.p: National City said Monday that net charge-offs totaled $32.6 million in the first quarter of the year, slightly higher than the $31.0 million for the same period last year.
The diversified financial services company said the amount represented 0.37 percent of average loans compared to 0.36 percent for the same period a year ago.
The company reported fully diluted earnings per share of $0.87 for the first quarter, a 10.1-percent increase over the $0.79 earned in 1996.
The rise in earnings was driven by growth in fee income and control of operating expenses, it said.
National City says it is a $50 billion company headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio.
